$comment: Accepted production advisories for .github/scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry (max ~3 months); an expired entry fails CI so the risk is re-checked. Never add an entry that has a fix: upgrade instead.

advisories.reason: No fixed release (all versions <= 1.4.0 affected). The flaw is in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification; we only parse PFX files and generate certificates, and never call forge's verify.
No fixed release (all versions <= 3.0.3 affected). Reached via chokidar/micromatch inside Docusaurus at build/dev time only; the wiki ships static HTML, and the glob patterns are our own config.
